title: piper persicariifolium
intro: Piper persicariifolium, commonly known as Kava-kava, is a plant native to the Pacific Island region, belonging to the pepper family (Piperaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Piper persicariifolium are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by bioactive constituents such as kavalactones and pipermethystine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include kavalactones (kawain, desmethoxyyangonin, yangonin, and dihydrokawain), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
